text: {"lessons":["Selling A, B, E, and D for gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a small profit; I should consider each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","I made no trades during the later declines, and account value moved both down and up; I should avoid reacting to short-term moves, while still reviewing my holdings periodically.","I tend to judge stocks against my own cost and feel gains and losses differently. I should focus on the value and risk of my whole portfolio, not let break-even or loss aversion dictate a decision."]}
